title: Boltslinger debloat
description: A Wynncraft QOL resource pack for boltslinger archers
body:
### Description
A Wynncraft resource pack aiming to improve boltslinger's gameplay readability and preserve your ears

### Entities
- Reduced arrow projectile size [All arrow based attacks]
- Reduced damage particle size [All projectiles]
- Reduced critical hit particle size [All projectiles]
- Reduced flame particle size [Buckshot]

### Sounds
- Reduced bow sfx volume [All arrow based attacks]
- Reduced hit sfx volume [All projectiles]
- Reduced tnt sfx volume [Exploding ID]

**Additional tip :** If you are using Warchief, Eschaton or any other equipment with the exploding ID, and if you are using Sodium + Sodium Extra, you can disable the vfx under Video Settings>Sodium Extra>Particles>Explosion
